$description: Code (platform/components/Code, inline code): its component tokens.

code-background.$description: Code: the neutral fill behind inline code.

code-text.$description: Code: the text color of inline code.

code-font-family.$description: Code: the code font (Reddit Mono); its size and line height are those of the text around it.

code-radius.$description: Code: the corners of the fill.

code-padding-inline.$description: Code: the space at the start and end of the fill.

code-on-accent-background.$description: Code: the fill of inline code on the accent surface.

code-on-accent-text.$description: Code: the text color of inline code on the accent surface.
